description: This file defines the CustomerOptionDao interface, which declares methods for accessing and manipulating CustomerOption entities in the database, including listing by store and language, saving or updating, and retrieving by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionDao
classes.description: An interface extending generic DAO for CustomerOption entities, providing methods to list options by store and language, save or update options, and retrieve options by code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOption instances associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new CustomerOption or updates an existing one; may throw ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOption based on store and unique option code.
